question.text: An unpolarized light beam is incident on the polarizer of a polarization experiment and the intensity of light beam emerging from the analyzer is measured as <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn></math> Lumens. Now, if the analyzer is rotated around the horizontal axis (direction of light) by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>30</mn><mo>°</mo></math> in clockwise direction, the intensity of emerging light will be _______Lumens.

solution.text:
Assuming initially axis of Polarizer and Analyzer are parallel

Now emerging intensity =I02cos230°

=100322=100×34=75
